title: Yochani bat Retivi

paragraphs: She is mentioned unfavorably in Sotah 22a. Rashi explains that she was a widow and sorceress who deceived people.

notes.text: The frozen text has לגגאי, read contextually as לגנאי, “unfavorably.” Rashi on Sotah22a describes the named widow’s deceptive sorcery. The exact changed letter remains a source question pending a matching scan.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume II, printed p. 653, reads לגנאי, “unfavorably,” supporting the English. The frozen transcription’s לגגאי remains unchanged in the Hebrew source. The consulted Rashi on Sotah 22a explicitly names Yochani bat Retivi and describes her deceptive sorcery. The earlier note’s pending scan check predates this inspection; it does not indicate another person named Gagai.
